citations.title: T500 operating manual
citations.excerpt: ## 5. Early warning signs An ESP runs at a steady speed, so a healthy T500 wellhead stays within a degree or two of its usual difference above air. ESP motors usually fail after running hot with too little fluid over the pump. In the weeks before a failure, the wellhead-to-air difference typically **falls steadily** while the well is still producing.

history.userText: Nathan told me the recalled pump on WELL-0577 was swapped as well. Take it off the recall list.
history.answer:
Relevant source passages:

supplier recall notice 2026 12 01 [SUPPLIER-RECALL-NOTICE-2026-12-01]:
## How to find affected pumps

The lot number is stamped on the pump barrel. Your crews record it when the pump is installed
(in your maintenance reports, on the line "Parts installed"). Only the pump that is in the well
today matters: a recalled pump that has already been pulled and replaced needs no action.
